programme.desc: Meeting an old flame (Geoff Stults) leads a woman (Shannon Elizabeth) to wonder if she's about to marry the right man (Eddie McClintock).

programme.title: dreamy bird
programme.desc: Huma asks Aziz to keep Can away from Sanem, as she believes she will make him suffer, but he has very different plans. Mevkibe and Nihat believe that Emre is deceiving Leyla and decide to follow him to discover the truth.

programme.title: dreamy bird
programme.desc: Nihat and Mevkibe show Leyla a video of Emre with another woman and assure her that he is cheating on her. Can and Emre discover that Yigit burned Sanem's notebook.

programme.title: dreamy bird

programme.title: dreamy bird
programme.desc: Deren discovers that a woman is selling Sanem's creams without his permission. Nihat and Mevkibe go to Emre in the office to give her a gift.

programme.title: Sandokan: The Pirate Prince
programme.desc: Sandokan and his men take refuge in Singapore, closely followed by Brooke and Murray. There, Marianne discovers another side of Sandokan, closer to its origins, and begins to get to know it better during the Lunar New Year celebrations.

programme.title: On the Edge of 18
programme.desc: Growing up is not easy for some. For Nadine, for example, a student who has to deal with the fact that her best friend is dating her older brother. She feels more alone than ever... Until she meets a young man who gives her all his attention...

programme.title: Doomsday Mom: The Lori Vallow Story
programme.desc: It is based on the true story of Lori Vallow, who gained national attention when her children, JJ and Tylee, were reported missing from their Idaho home in the fall of 2019.

programme.title: The force of nature
programme.desc: A gang of thieves plans to rob a building, taking advantage of the arrival of a storm, but the strategy fails when the police want to evacuate the residents from their homes due to the arrival of a category 5 hurricane.

programme.title: S.W.A.T.: Harrelson's Men
programme.desc: Jim Street, former member of the S.W.A.T, was expelled from the team along with his partner Brian Gamble, due to a controversial decision he made in a robbery with hostages case. For Street, his work is his life and he is looking for the opportunity to wear the uniform again. That opportunity comes when Dan "Hondo" Harrelson, the team's commander, must recruit and train five high-level police officers for a new special weapons and tactics team. After a few hard weeks of training, the team goes into action: a drug lord offers a large sum of money to whoever frees him from police control. The S.W.A.T. team He must guard the enemy while being chased by a band of mercenaries. Film version of the famous 70's television series "Harrelson's Men".

programme.title: Asterix and Obelix against Caesar
programme.desc: The small village of Asterix and Obelix is ​​the last place that is not under the control of Rome. When the tax collector doesn't get money from its inhabitants, Julius Caesar goes to see what's so special about them.

programme.title: Asterix and Obelix: Mission Cleopatra
programme.desc: The action takes place in the year LII BC. Although not all of Gaul is yet occupied, Egypt, ruled by the powerful Cleopatra, has fallen under the yoke of the Roman Empire. Fed up with Caesar's sarcasm, the proud and beautiful queen makes a bet with him: if he manages to build a palace in the space of three months, he will recognize that the Egyptian people are the greatest of all. Cleopatra entrusts such an impossible mission to Numerobis, an emerging avant-garde architect who undertakes a journey to Gaul to ask for help from Asterix and Obelix.

programme.title: Darrow y Darrow: En clave de asesinato
programme.desc: Claire and Miles go on a date at the club where Miles' little sister sings. The next day she is arrested for murdering the music producer she just fired and Claire takes the case.

programme.title: Adoptive parents
programme.desc: Coline and André are in perfect harmony with their daughter, Garance, and their son-in-law Harold. But Garance separates from Harold and orders his parents to never see him again, the in-laws cannot do it. They will have to lead a double life to continue seeing their beloved son-in-law.

programme.title: Exposed
programme.desc: Milo Boyd, a bounty hunter who is going through a bad streak, is assigned the case of his dreams: capturing his ex-wife, journalist Nicole Hurley, who has violated parole. Milo thinks it will be a fun job, but Nicole has run away to investigate a murder, so things won't be so simple. Suddenly, their lives begin to be in danger and they have to flee. If you thought the promise to love and respect each other was difficult, staying alive will be much more complicated.

programme.title: The mask of Zorro
programme.desc: 1821. The Mexican army strives to liberate its country from the Spanish yoke. In the Californias area, the evil Spanish governor, Don Rafael Montero, is about to lose everything. In a last attempt to catch his nemesis, the masked swordsman "Zorro", Montoro prepares to murder three innocents. With the help of two orphans, Joaquín and Alejandro Murrieta, Zorro frees the prisoners. Then he will give both boys a special medallion and flee on his horse, Tornado, after marking Montero with a small "Z" on his neck as a warning. But that same night the soldiers enter the house of a nobleman named Don Diego de la Vega and arrest him since they are convinced that he is the real Zorro. Don Diego's wife dies, he is locked up in prison and his daughter, Elena, is taken to Spain as Montoro's daughter, where he will raise her as if she were his own. Twenty years later, Montoro secretly returns to California and looks for Diego in prison but cannot find him because he is unrecognizable due to age. However, the prisoner does remember the man and with a thirst for revenge like he had never had before, he escapes from prison and decides to put an end to his enemy forever. Along the way he will discover Elena, his daughter, who is as beautiful as her mother when she was murdered. Tired, old and completely destroyed by the years of captivity, Don Diego de la Vega will decide to train an adult Alejandro Muerrieta, now a bandit and rogue, to become the new Zorro and avenge all the suffering that the evil Rafael Montero caused him. At first Anthony Hopkins rejected the role of Don Diego de la Vega because he had unbearable pain in his back. When a laser operation managed to alleviate the problem, he then offered to accept playing the wise old "Zorro."

programme.title: The legend of Zorro
programme.desc: 1850. California has been tortured by the colonizers for years but will finally become the thirty-first state of the Union. Zorro suspects that a group of individuals intend to sabotage this decision for their own benefit, so he will stop them in a heroic feat. At the same time, McGivens, a French baron, is dedicated to blackmailing the inhabitants of California to keep their lands and leaving those who earned their living from the countryside in absolute poverty. Don Alejandro de la Vega, the one nicknamed "Zorro" with his mask, his sword, his horse and his cape, has finally been able to marry the beautiful Elena and has a ten-year-old son named Joaquín. The little boy misses his father, whom he hardly sees, and on the other hand idealizes the figure of his hero, Zorro, without knowing what his true identity is. Alejandro promises to leave the mask behind forever and dedicate himself to his family, but when a new crisis appears in California, he acts once again to solve it. Elena, feeling cheated, kicks her husband out of the house and presents him with divorce papers. At that moment, an old companion of the woman arrives at the scene: the French aristocrat Army. When he finds out about Elena's separation, he immediately begins to court her while attending to his affairs in the secret brotherhood in which he is involved. Now Alejandro will have to choose between alleviating the suffering of the oppressed or returning to his family. But to do so he must defeat the always shady Baron Army. For "The Legend of Zorro" both Steven Spielberg and Robert Rodriguez planned to direct the film, but in the end they did not take the job, although Spielberg did stay on as executive producer.

programme.title: Siege status
programme.desc: Third collaboration between director Edward Zwick and Denzel Washington after "Glory Times (1989)" where he won his first Oscar for Best Supporting Actor and "In Honor of the Truth" (1996) and magnificent hand in hand full of tension between Denzel Washington and Bruce Willis. New York City becomes the target of a wave of terrorist attacks. FBI agent Anthony Hubbard (Denzel Washington) is appointed head of the joint anti-terrorist force and together with CIA agent Elise Kraft (Annette Bening), with important contacts in the Arab-American community, they will be in charge of arresting those responsible. Meanwhile, the government declares martial law and sends General William Deveraux (Bruce Willis) to command the troops in charge of occupying the city.

programme.title: Llamaradas
programme.desc: He was a child when he witnessed the death of his father in an act of service during a fire. Twenty years later, Brian is also a firefighter in Chicago. He is in a difficult trial period led by his brother Stephen who is very demanding of him. Both brothers will try to overcome disputes and memories of the past while an arsonist sets fires in the city.

programme.title: Awakenings
programme.desc: In the mid-1960s, Dr. Malcolm Sayer, a New York neurologist, decided to subject his encephalitis patients to a complex experiment. It is a disease that deprives people who suffer from it of their motor skills until they are reduced to a vegetative state. The new therapy will slowly begin to have results, especially in one patient, Leonard Lowe.

programme.title: The Pelican Report
programme.desc: Two judges of the Superior Court of Justice have been murdered. Now, a university professor who knows both victims will find himself involved in the case in a terrible way. One of his students, with whom he is having a relationship, makes a short report of who might want the men dead and gives it to her teacher. He, amazed by the intuition of Darby Shawn, the student, will give the brief report to one of his friends who works for the FBI. What was not expected is that when they began to analyze it, they were completely fascinated to discover its content. But one of the president's men fears that this report will end up tarnishing his image, so he forces the director to get rid of the papers. Meanwhile, drunk, the professor and Darby argue and when she refuses to give him the keys to her car, it suddenly explodes into a thousand pieces. Terrified, she runs home but sees that they have turned everything upside down and some attackers have taken her computer and hard drives. Darby finds himself in the middle of a huge problem that he couldn't even foresee and although he asks a friend from the FBI for help, he turns up dead just before they meet. The report she has written seems to have enraged a very powerful group of men who will now not hesitate for a second to kill everyone who read it and especially the one who wrote it. The rights to "The Pelican Brief" were sold before the book was even written. John Grisham had only a small outline of what the plot would be like when the production company bought the rights. In fact, writer John Grisham wrote the Darby Shaw parts with Julia Roberts in mind. Julia read the book when it was published and accepted the role without even glancing at the script.

programme.title: Demolition
programme.desc: A successful executive struggles to understand his emotional disconnection after the sudden and tragic death of his wife in a car accident. Despite his father-in-law's pressure to recover, Davis remains bewildered and reflects this by compulsively disassembling increasingly conspicuous objects around him.

programme.title: Cross-fire
programme.desc: After witnessing the brutal murder of a store owner and his son, firefighter Jeremy Coleman miraculously escapes with his life. Having witnessed the murders and being forced to testify against the gang of gangsters that carried them out, specifically against their leader, David Hagan, he is integrated into the witness protection program under the supervision of the Marshalls. Agent Talia will be in charge of protecting Jeremy's life from this cruel murderer. Inspector Mike Calla will be in charge of handling Coleman's case, a man who precisely lost his wife at the hands of the same gangster who committed this crime, and who since then has not stopped searching for him to do justice. The problem comes when Jeremy Coleman's new identity is compromised, so the firefighter is forced to take action to recover his life and save those of his loved ones.

programme.title: Shark week
programme.desc: Shark experts return to Plettenberg, South Africa, with new technology: a seal-shaped decoy to study and capture the dramatic battles between sharks and seals.

programme.title: The seventh son
programme.desc: Centuries ago, Master Gregory captured the evil and powerful witch Malkin. But the witch managed to escape and prepares her revenge. Meanwhile, Master Gregory sets out to teach his young apprentice Tom Ward to fight black magic in record time.

programme.title: The source of life
programme.desc: An odyssey about a man's fight to save the woman he loves in three time spaces: the 21st century, the conquest of America, and the future.

programme.title: 10 minutes less
programme.desc: Frank is a criminal who, together with his companions, tries to rob a bank. However, the police end up being alerted and while trying to flee, a mysterious assailant hits Frank on the head, causing him to lose part of his memory. Rex, the leader of the gang, awaits answers about the failed robbery, while Frank will try to do everything possible to recover the 10 minutes that have disappeared from his memory and find the person responsible for his fall from grace.

programme.title: Bloodshot
programme.desc: Upon returning from a mission in Mombasa, elite soldier Ray Garrison and his wife are kidnapped and murdered. Shortly after, Ray awakens in the Spirit Reborn Project facility with no memory of his past.

programme.title: The silence of the lambs
programme.desc: Promising FBI agent Clarice Starling is pulled from her special forces training by Jack Crawford of the FBI's Behavioral Study Unit. He wants me to study a notorious and eccentric psychopath named Habbibal Lecter, who was a forensic psychiatrist imprisoned for multiple murders and cannibalism. The purpose of the meetings between Clarice and Hannibal must be for the latter to agree to help her catch a serial killer named Buffalo Bill. But what the woman did not imagine was that Hannibal would turn out to be a sophisticated and cultured man restricted from others by glass walls. Although he is polite at first, he soon begins to lose patience when Clarice tries to create a psychological profile for him. While the hunts continue throughout Chicago and Buffalo Bill collects his kills without the FBI being able to do anything to solve it, Clarice will have to find a way to ingratiate herself with a man who ate the people around him and show him that, in addition to being intelligent, she is not afraid of him at all. Things will start to get difficult when the Senator's daughter disappears and everything indicates that Buffalo Bill has her and that soon her body will appear as a new victim. The events of this film take place after what happened in the film Hunter (1986). Although there are many characters in common in the two films, only two of the actors share films. Frankie Faison plays Lt. Fisk in Hunter and Barney in The Silence of the Lambs; On the other hand, Dan Butler plays the fingerprint expert FBI agent in Hunter and an entomologist in "The Silence of the Lambs."

programme.title: Asterix and Obelix against Caesar
programme.desc: The small village of Asterix and Obelix is ​​the last place that is not under the control of Rome. When the tax collector doesn't get money from its inhabitants, Julius Caesar goes to see what's so special about them.

programme.title: Asterix and Obelix: Mission Cleopatra

Cleopatra entrusts such an impossible mission to Numerobis, an emerging avant-garde architect who undertakes a journey to Gaul to ask for help from Asterix and Obelix.

programme.title: hidden figures
programme.desc: As a child, African-American Katherine proved to be a mathematical prodigy. Now, as an adult, she works for NASA... but in the USA of 1961, as a woman and black, her brilliant work means very little.

programme.title: The jewel of the Nile
programme.desc: Jack and Joan are about to get married on a boat on the high seas. But suddenly a horde of pirates attack them and set fire to the facilities. Joan and Jack fight off the tenacious pirates when they realize there is only one place left on the lifeboat. Joan asks Jack to take care of it since she is going to die soon of tuberculosis and it is not worth the man dying. When he leaves she wonders what the buccaneers will do and what her future will be... But this incredible adventure was only part of Joan Wilder's fantasy with which she intends to start writing her new book, in which she is stuck. She has been married to Jack Colton for some time and after the incredible adventures they have had, they find themselves stuck in a port in the south of France bound for Greece, although she would prefer to go to New York. That same afternoon, at a book signing, Joan meets Omar, a benevolent ruler of an Eastern country called Kadir. He invites her to his palace so she can feel like a queen while he writes, but Jack is not amused by this proposal. Quarreled, they decide to separate and take some time while she finishes her book. Suddenly, Joan witnesses how a man named Tarak tries to murder Omar in front of her. For his part, Jack meets a man named Ralph at the port who seeks revenge for his time spent in prison. They both see how a man approaches: it is Tarak, the murderer, who comes to ask them for help. He confesses to them that Omar is actually a horrible dictator who has stolen their most precious treasure, "The Jewel of the Nile." Jack decides to help him when he sees his ship explode and understands that the sheikh intended to kill him and thus, in the process, rescues his wife. But the sheik has great power and it will be very difficult for Jack and Ralph to get their way. The actors who play the tribesmen: Arak, Barak, Karak, Sarak and Tarak, the same ones from the troop of jugglers in The Brothers Karamazov.

programme.title: Jumanji
programme.desc: Alan Parrish is a boy who accidentally finds a board game called Jumanji and convinces his friend Sarah to try it, but very strange events begin to occur and the game will catch them and change their lives. By throwing the dice, Alan is transported to a parallel world, where he will not be able to leave until the game ends, but circumstances cause Sarah to leave and Alan is trapped for 26 years in that other world until two new children find the game and start playing.

programme.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the jungle
programme.desc: In 1996, a teenager disappears after opening a strange board game. Twenty years later, the sporty Fridge, the pretty Bethany, the geeky Spencer and the clever Martha are punished to clean a classroom at their high school, where they discover an old video game.

programme.title: Jumanji: next level
programme.desc: The lives of Spencer, Martha, Bethany and Fridge have gone their separate ways. The two girls and the sporty Fridge are eager to meet again for Christmas, but Spencer is not so sure.

programme.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
programme.desc: Peter Parker was abandoned by his parents when he was still a child, and was raised by his Uncle Ben and Aunt May. Somewhat marginalized at school, Peter wants to know his past and find out who he is, but there he meets his first love, Gwen Stacy. When Peter discovers a briefcase that belonged to his father, he begins a quest to learn how his parents disappeared, something that will take him to Oscorp and the laboratory of his father's former partner, Dr. Connor, where he is bitten by an experimentally modified spider that gives him incredible powers. The murder of his uncle by a thief will make him seek revenge, catching the criminals he finds in his path, so he realizes that his destiny is to help people. But Dr. Connor, in turn, is forced to test his own experiment (a lizard serum that regenerates body limbs) on himself after his dismissal, which turns him into The Lizard. This will spread panic among the citizens, and Peter will be forced to use his powers. It is the first film of a cinematographic reboot of this character, since due to script problems Sony had canceled the fourth installment of Spider-Man, opting for this reboot. Marc Webb is in charge of directing the film, and he specializes in the world of music videos, in which groups such as Green Day, My Chemical Romance, Evanescence, Maroon 5 and Fergie have featured him. His only films are (500) Days Together and the first and second installment of this new Spider-Man saga. Andrew Garfield plays Peter Parker. He began in theater and acted in Leones por Corderos and the television film Boy A, which gave him recognition; just like his performance in The Social Network. Emma Stone plays Gwen Stacy, and participated in films such as Campus Bunny, Ghosts of My Ex-Girlfriends, Crazy, Stupid, Love or Entitled to Friction. His role in Easy A earned him a Golden Globe nomination.

programme.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2: El poder de Electro
programme.desc: Peter Parker leads a very busy life: he has to save the city from bad guys and also continue with his university life to take care of Gwen, although from a distance. Things get complicated when the villain Electro appears with a thirst for revenge. However, it won't be the only thing Peter has to face, as the return of an old friend, Harry Osborn, brings new clues about his past.

programme.title: The force of nature
programme.desc: A gang of thieves plans to rob a building, taking advantage of the arrival of a storm, but the strategy fails when the police want to evacuate the residents from their homes due to the arrival of a category 5 hurricane.

programme.title: Shark, revenge
programme.desc: Years pass and Ellen Brody continues to live in Amyty. Her sons, Sean and Micahel, no longer work at Sea World and her husband passed away some time ago due to cardiac arrest. Currently, Sean is the city's police officer. On Christmas night, he receives the order to go to the beach to unscrew a log from a buoy. In the process he is eaten by a great white shark. Convinced that the sharks have some kind of vendetta against her family, Ellen travels with Michael, his wife and daughter to a house they have in the Bahamas. What Ellen and her family don't know is that the threat has followed them there. The film's main tagline, 'This time it's personal', was parodied in 'Back to the Future II'. In the film you can see a poster for the fictional 'Jaws 19', directed by Max Spielberg and whose slogan is 'This time it's very personal.' This phrase has ended up becoming a cliché in movies with many sequels. Actor Michael Caine could not attend the Oscars and collect his award for 'Hannah and Her Sisters', because he was filming this film at that time. The water in the tank in which the film's climax was shot was filled with blue dye, so Micahel Caine and Lorraine Gary ended up with their hair completely dyed this color. Lorraine Gary was nominated for Best Actress at the United States Academy Awards for Science Fiction, Fantasy and Horror.

programme.title: The seventh son
programme.desc: Centuries ago, Master Gregory captured the evil and powerful witch Malkin. But the witch managed to escape and prepares her revenge. Meanwhile, Master Gregory sets out to teach his young apprentice Tom Ward to fight black magic in record time.

programme.title: The source of life
programme.desc: An odyssey about a man's fight to save the woman he loves in three time spaces: the 21st century, the conquest of America, and the future.

programme.title: Adoptive parents
programme.desc: Coline and André are in perfect harmony with their daughter, Garance, and their son-in-law Harold. But Garance separates from Harold and orders his parents to never see him again, the in-laws cannot do it. They will have to lead a double life to continue seeing their beloved son-in-law.

programme.title: A town called Dante's Peak
programme.desc: Harry Dalton (Pierce Brosnan) is one of the most renowned volcanologists at the United States Geological Survey. Four years after his partner's death during a volcanic eruption in Colombia, Harry receives a call from his boss, Paul Dyfrus (Charles Hallahan), to discuss the unusual behavior of a hitherto dormant volcano. Meanwhile, the city of Dante's Peak, located on one of the volcano's plains, is celebrating being named the second most desired place to live in the country. Harry begins his investigation in the area and discovers clear signs that the volcano could soon erupt. The scientist wants to put the city on alert, but the inhabitants have economic interests that could be harmed if they heed Harry's warnings. Everyone ignores it until it's too late. The director, Roger Donaldson, was drawn to the project because he was once a geology student. Many of the film's special effects were done practically. The ash from the volcano was actually very fine shavings of newspaper. According to an interview with Donaldson, the camera that Harry Dalton uses during his investigation is actually owned by Pierce Brosnan. Initially the main role was going to be played by Michael Douglas. Most of the film's exteriors were shot in Wallas, Idaho. It was also filmed on Dante's Peak, adding certain details with digital technology.

programme.title: Exposed
programme.desc: Milo Boyd, a bounty hunter who is going through a bad streak, is assigned the case of his dreams: capturing his ex-wife, journalist Nicole Hurley, who has violated parole. Milo thinks it will be a fun job, but Nicole has run away to investigate a murder, so things won't be so simple. Suddenly, their lives begin to be in danger and they have to flee. If you thought the promise to love and respect each other was difficult, staying alive will be much more complicated.

programme.title: Escape from Alcatraz
programme.desc: Frank Morris, a prisoner specialized in escapes with a very high intelligence quotient, is imprisoned in Alcatraz prison. In his head he keeps preparing an escape plan that will not be risk-free.

programme.title: Hulk
programme.desc: Bruce Banner is a renowned scientist, with a murky family past, who suffers with his team a serious laboratory accident in which everyone is exposed to intense gamma radiation. When he discovers that he is the only one who has survived, he is confused and begins to investigate. But Bruce has developed a terrible ability after the accident that could hinder the investigation; when he gets angry he turns into a giant green monster with irrational and destructive behavior. To create the Hulk character using digital technology, the company Light & Magic made the largest technical deployment in its history. It was necessary to work together with one hundred and eighty ILM technicians and work on the character for more than a year and a half. Even so, there are viewers who have compared the technical quality of the Hulk to that of Shrek. In this film, Hulk reaches the largest size he had reached to date, nine meters tall. Ang Lee used the split-screen technique to cinematically imitate the panels of a comic book page. To do this, he had to shoot the same scene several times, which somewhat exhausted actor Eric Bana, who plays Brece Banner. Much of the microbiology work seen on screen is real, done by Ang Lee's wife.

programme.title: Speed: Maximum power
programme.desc: Jack Traven is a young and intrepid Los Angeles SWAT police officer, who to date has succeeded in each of his missions. But this time the danger seems greater and less manageable. He has been locked in a bus with several passengers and a terrorist threatens to blow it up if he is not given three million dollars. If the bus exceeds eighty kilometers per hour or brakes, it will also explode. Just like if any of the passengers decide to get out of the vehicle. Jack is then forced to devise all kinds of strategies to save his life and that of all the civilians who accompany him in this race against time. Actress Sandra Bullock had to learn to drive a bus to play her role in the film. He passed the exam on the first try. According to Graham Yost, Joss Whedon wrote most of the dialogue, he is just not credited as a co-writer. Joss Whedon is the creator of the series 'Buffy the Vampire Slayer' and the director of films such as 'The Avengers' and 'The Cabin in the Woods'. Keanu Reeves initially turned down the role of Jack Traven, thinking the film would be too similar to Die Hard. He only accepted the role after Joss Whedon redesigned the script. The actor did ninety percent of the stunts that corresponded to his character.

programme.title: Dari Nada Turun Ke Hati
programme.desc: Prisa, seorang mahasiswi baru jurusan musik, sedang berusaha mencari partitur lagu yang akan dimainkannya saat Ujian Akhir Semester. Dia pun berangkat ke sebuah perpustakaan musik dan bertemu Edwin.

programme.title: Petaka Topi Pemikat
programme.desc: Annisa kehilangan nenek yang merawatnya sejak kecil, ia difitnah para tetangga yang menuduhnya menjual rujak beracun. Kehidupan Annisa berubah saat mendapat topi pancar pesona dari toko KR. Amat. Setelah itu keanehan pun terjadi.

programme.title: Ronggeng Village Invitation
programme.desc: Agni mendapat undangan untuk menghadiri Pertunjukkan Seni Tari Ronggeng di kampung Ronggeng.Tidak diketahui siapa pengirim undangan itu.Agni dan kedua temannya memutuskan untuk datang . Kejadian-kejadian aneh pun mereka alami.

programme.title: Terperangkap Di Alas Roban
programme.desc: Saat pulang dari liburan, bus yang ditumpangi Muham dan temannya mogok tepat di tengah wilayah angker. Mereka menolong seorang gadis yang ternyata disandera makhluk misterius di sana.

programme.title: Pliss Gue Bukan Princess
programme.desc: Genta mengenalkan Alila, pacarnya, ke ibunya. Namun, Alila dianggap kurang feminin, sehingga ibu Genta memberi waktu agar Alila bisa berubah.

programme.title: Mirror World
programme.desc: Vuri adalah siswi SMA yang menjadi bahan olok-olok dan ketinggalan dalam pelajaran sekolah. Hingga dia menemukan sebuah cermin yang membawanya ke dunia lain yang keadaannya berbeda 180 derajat dengan dunianya sekarang.

programme.title: Bidadari Di Kebun Strawberry
programme.desc: Misi yang dijalankan seharusnya mudah, yaitu menaikkan penjualan strawberry, tapi ada saja yang menghalangi usahanya termasuk pria tampan yang tiba-tiba muncul.

programme.title: Cintaku Tak Seindah FTV
programme.desc: Ada tetangga baru yang bikin Alya kepincut dengan ketampanannya. Ramzi, cowok ganteng dan keren itu bikin Alya penasaran. Alya seorang penulis FTV, kerap menulis cerita percintaan. Apakah kisah nyatanya bakal seindah cerita FTV?

programme.title: Mantan Yang Tak Diundang
programme.desc: Ketika sedang berjalan dengan pacarnya, Kiena bertemu David, mantan pacarnya dulu. Yosha, pacar Kiena merasa kesal David yang sering mengajak Kiena jalan. Apakah Kiena tetap setia dengan Yosha? Atau kembali dengan mantannya?

programme.title: Kr. Amat Bone Bracelet Shop
programme.desc: Berawal dari kesusahan yang mendera keluarganya Ratu dan Panji mencuri sepasang gelang tulang yang dapat menembus benda padat sesuai kehendak mereka. Namun mereka tak menyadari bahwa gelang tulang itu membawa petaka.

programme.title: Kepentok Cinta Sementara
programme.desc: Arga diultimatum pihak kampus untuk melunasi biaya kuliah, Arga sama sekali tidak mempunyai uang. Beruntung ada Bonar yang bersedia meminjamkan uang, namun ada syaratnya yaitu, menjadi pacar sementara adiknya.

programme.title: MJ is beautiful
programme.desc: Jamilah pengagum berat Michael Jackson, memutuskan untuk melanjutkan sekolah di Jakarta agar bisa bertemu dengan idolanya, Fadly Jackson. Namun yang dia dapatkan adalah ejekan dan hinaan. Berhasilkah Jamilah mewujudkan impiannya?

programme.title: Kupanjat Pinang Demi Cinta
programme.desc: Elang kesal karena dipaksa ikut lomba perayaan kemerdekaan oleh neneknya. Elang pun kerap berselisih paham dengan Laras, anak dari Pak RT. Mampukah Elang menang lomba panjat pinang?

programme.title: Kalau Lupa Jangan Cinta
programme.desc: Neneng, gadis desa yang lugu datang ke Jakarta untuk mencari Ujang, pacarnya. Neneng diajak tinggal di rumah Alfian tanpa sepengetahuan orang tuanya. Kegaduhan terjadi di rumah saat Nadya, pacar Alfian datang ke rumah Alfian.

programme.title: Petaka Penyihir Cinta
programme.desc: Di hari ulang tahunnya yang ke-18, Amanda membuka surat dari almarhum ibunya dan mengetahui siapa dirinya sebenarnya. Ternyata dia adalah keturunan penyihir, dan baru mendapatkan kekuatannya setelah berusia 18 tahun.

programme.title: 7 Hari Kemudian
programme.desc: Mike, cowok playboy sekolah terkenal suka mempermainkan cewek. Fika mantan pacar Mike meninggal dunia karena bunuh diri. Amanda dan teman-temannya berencana membuat jera Mike. Mereka mengatur strategi untuk menjebak Mike.

programme.title: Orang Sakti Penabur Cinta
programme.desc: Sakit hati karena cintanya, Rian bersumpah tidak akan ada lelaki lain yang bisa mendekati Intan. Intan yang putus asa meminta bantuan kepada orang sakti penabur cinta, namun ternyata orang tersebut tidak seperti yang diduganya.

programme.title: Orang Sakti Penabur Cinta
programme.desc: Sakit hati karena cintanya, Rian bersumpah tidak akan ada lelaki lain yang bisa mendekati Intan. Intan yang putus asa meminta bantuan kepada orang sakti penabur cinta, namun ternyata orang tersebut tidak seperti yang diduganya.

programme.title: Breaking News 'Upacara Pengibaran Bendera Ke - 81 HUT Kemerdekaan RI'

My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: Mei Li muda bekerja sebagai pelayan bar di Wanchai untuk mencari nafkah. Ia jatuh cinta pada Jimmy saat bertemu dengannya di sana. Namun, Mei Li merasa sangat terpukul saat Jimmy harus pergi.

programme.title: Big Times For Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Sekelompok pemuda dusun yang kocak kembali untuk ke-tiga kalinya! Ah Niu sedang mengerjakan urusannya saat sekantong berlian jatuh dari langit, dan kejadian ini hanyalah awal dari serangkaian kesialan!

programme.title: Disciples Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Yi, seorang ahli kungfu gaya Hong Quan bekerja di pabrik tekstil yang direkomendasikan oleh Han, seniornya. Han memperingatkan Yi untuk tidak memamerkan keahlian seni bela dirinya agar tak mendapat masalah.

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: Ti Lung yang hidup di Gunung Ular Kwangsi bersama dengan saudaranya, Ular Hitam dan Ular Kuning, telah berusaha untuk berubah menjadi manusia selama seribu tahun.

programme.title: Return Of The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Film sekuel ini bercerita tentang imigran Yeh Feng yang kabur dari penjara untuk tinggal bersama paman Wang Sha yang jahat. Namun, ternyata kekasihnya, Ai Ti, telah menikah dengan seorang pria yang kasar.

programme.title: Legend Of The Bat
programme.desc: Pendekar pedang karismatik, Chu Liu Hsiang pergi ke Pulau Kelelawar. Di sana ia bertemu dengan para biksu, wanita serta berbagai aksi petualangan!

programme.title: The Story Of Sue San
programme.desc: Wang adalah putra pejabat pemerintah yang dihormati, sedangkan Sue San adalah seorang wanita penghibur nan terkenal. Meskipun dan terlihat cocok dan saling mencintai, keduanya sangat berbeda dalam tingkatan sosial.

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: Kisah legendaris yang bercerita tentang keberanian dan kepahlawanan ini dibintangi oleh Ivy Ling Po yang berperan sebagai Mulan, gadis yang bergabung dengan tentara dan menjadi pahlawan sejati bagi warga Tiongkok.

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: Tiga gadis pergi ke Jepang untuk mengambil warisan yang tak terduga dan bertemu tiga pria dengan niat yang sama. Pertarungan sengit pun terjadi untuk memperebutkan warisan tersebut.

Po adalah seorang anak dengan spektrum autisme yang memiliki cara unik dalam melihat dan memahami dunia di sekitarnya. Di tengah kesedihan, tekanan hidup, dan tantangan sebagai orang tua tunggal, David berusaha memberikan yang terbaik untuk putranya. Perjalanan mereka mengajarkan arti kasih sayang, penerimaan, kesabaran, dan kekuatan hubungan antara ayah dan anak.

Demi menyelamatkan anaknya, Mona berpegang teguh pada keyakinannya dan mencari keajaiban melalui doa serta bimbingan spiritual. Namun, dalam perjalanannya, ia mulai menghadapi pertanyaan sulit mengenai iman, keluarga, pengorbanan, dan batas antara harapan serta kenyataan.

Di tengah medan yang penuh tantangan, ia menghadapi berbagai bahaya, bertemu orang-orang yang membantunya, serta menunjukkan keberanian dan kesetiaan yang luar biasa. Hero Dog: The Journey Home menghadirkan kisah petualangan keluarga yang hangat tentang arti persahabatan, harapan, dan ikatan istimewa antara manusia dan sahabat berkaki empatnya.

programme.title: The Salvation
programme.desc: The Salvation mengisahkan Jon Jensen, seorang imigran Denmark yang hidup sebagai pemukim di Amerika Barat pada tahun 1870-an. Setelah menunggu bertahun-tahun untuk berkumpul kembali dengan keluarganya, kebahagiaannya berubah menjadi tragedi ketika istri dan anaknya dibunuh oleh para penjahat. Dengan rasa kehilangan dan amarah, Jon memburu para pelaku dan tindakannya tersebut memicu konflik besar dengan pemimpin geng kriminal yang menguasai sebuah kota kecil. Dalam perjuangannya mencari keadilan, Jon harus menghadapi pengkhianatan, kekuasaan yang korup, dan kerasnya kehidupan di wilayah perbatasan.

Dengan dukungan teman-temannya, Rob mencoba bangkit dengan membuka sebuah restoran di pedesaan. Saat restoran tersebut mulai berkembang, ia bertemu dengan seorang kritikus makanan yang awalnya menantang dirinya, namun perlahan membuka peluang bagi hubungan baru. Film ini menghadirkan kisah tentang cinta, penyembuhan, impian, dan kesempatan kedua dalam hidup.

programme.title: Inside Iran: War & Revolution
programme.desc: Following unprecedented protests and a devastating military conflict, Iranian citizens are risking their lives to share what truly happened inside their country. The film features exclusive, on-the-ground footage and interviews with ordinary people, journalists, and grieving families - many speaking anonymously - who survived the brutal 2026 uprising and subsequent war. Through their detailed first-hand accounts, this documentary - for the BAFTA-winning ITV Exposure strand - explores how the Islamic Republic's ruthless crackdown on civilian demonstrations escalated into a terrifying international crisis. Their testimonies expose harrowing scenes of internet blackouts, state-sanctioned killings of unarmed protesters, and the devastating reality of life under US and Israeli bombardment. The film pieces together a rare, unfiltered picture from inside Iran - capturing a resilient population caught in the deadly crossfire of domestic authoritarianism and global warfare.

The fault means that the mission cannot land on the Moon - in fact, it is so fatal that it is likely that the crew will perish in space without a solution to their problems being found. With the help of ex-crewmate Ken Mattingly and NASA Flight Director Gene Kranz, NASA and the crew are forced to improvise solutions to a series of onboard problems in order to get their stricken craft back to Earth.

programme.title: The Goblin
programme.desc: Doo Hyeon yang dikenal dengan nama "Goblin" masuk penjara karena jatuh cinta pada Yeong Min yang membunuh bosnya. Setelah 10 tahun, Doo Hyeon dibebaskan dan telah menjalani kehidupan normal. Namun, dia harus menerima kenyataan bahwa Yeong Min telah memanfaatkan namanya "Goblin". Yeong Min bahkan menculik putrinya untuk tutup mulut. Doo Hyeon marah, melakukan balas dendam dan mengumumkan kembalinya "Goblin" yang asli.

programme.title: 6/45: Lucky Lotto
programme.desc: Kegembiraan karena menang lotre tak berlangsung lama bagi sersan Chun-woo sebab secara tak sengaja tiket lotre tersebut melintasi Garis Demarkasi Militer. Ia harus mengendalikan dirinya dan menemukan jalan keluar!

programme.title: The Childe
programme.desc: Marco, seorang petinju yang lahir dari ayah Korea dan ibu Filipina. Akibat kesulitan keuangan dan ibu yang sakit-sakitan, Marco memutuskan pergi ke Korea Selatan untuk mencari keberadaan sang ayah yang sejak kecil meninggalkannya. Setibanya di Korea Selatan, Marco mendadak menjadi buronan seorang pria misterius dan sekelompok orang jahat yang tak pernah berhenti mengejarnya.

programme.title: Noryang: Deadly Sea (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Berlatar musim dingin tahun 1598, cerita tentang pertempuran laut terakhir Yi Sun-shin selama invasi Jepang ke Korea yang terjadi di Selat Noryang.

programme.title: Love 911
programme.desc: Ketika seorang dokter dituntut karena salah mendiagnosis pasien, dia menghubungi petugas pemadam kebakaran yang berdedikasi untuk menjadi saksi karakternya. Kisah cinta yang tidak terduga muncul di antara mereka berdua.

programme.title: Dragon Inn: The City Of Sadness
programme.desc: Dragon Inn: The City of Sadness mengisahkan sebuah organisasi vigilante yang beroperasi secara rahasia di balik sebuah restoran bernama Dragon Inn. Kelompok ini menjalankan misinya sendiri untuk menghukum para pelaku kejahatan yang tidak tersentuh hukum. Setiap anggota memiliki masa lalu kelam dan alasan pribadi yang mendorong mereka bergabung. Situasi berubah ketika putra seorang pengusaha terkenal ditemukan tewas dan salah satu anggota Dragon Inn diduga terlibat dalam kasus tersebut. Di tengah penyelidikan, berbagai rahasia, pengkhianatan, dan konflik berdarah mulai terungkap. Para anggota harus berjuang menghadapi musuh dari luar sekaligus mempertahankan kepercayaan satu sama lain dalam dunia yang dipenuhi korupsi dan balas dendam.

programme.title: Killing Romance

programme.title: The Glorious My Revenge

programme.title: Dragon Inn: Night Of Salvation
programme.desc: Dragon Inn: Night of Salvation melanjutkan kisah organisasi rahasia Dragon Inn yang menjalankan misinya sendiri untuk menghukum para pelaku kejahatan yang lolos dari hukum. Kali ini mereka menerima kasus hilangnya seorang gadis remaja yang tidak memiliki alasan untuk melarikan diri dari rumah. Dalam proses penyelidikan, mereka menemukan keterkaitan antara kasus tersebut dengan sebuah sekte keagamaan yang beroperasi secara mencurigakan. Ketika identitas dan lokasi Dragon Inn terbongkar akibat sebuah kesalahan, para anggota organisasi harus menghadapi ancaman yang semakin besar. Di tengah pertarungan melawan kelompok berbahaya tersebut, mereka berusaha menyelamatkan korban sekaligus mengungkap kebenaran di balik jaringan kejahatan yang tersembunyi. Film ini menghadirkan perpaduan aksi, misteri, dan ketegangan yang lebih intens dibanding pendahulunya.

programme.title: Crash
programme.desc: When ambition exceeds driving ability and when well-secured racing professionals are carried out of the curve, then we are there with the camera. programme.title: Dumbest Stuff on Wheels
programme.desc: Bizarre mishaps, weird crashes and unbelievable nonsense on four wheels, fabricated in everyday life and immortalized on camera. Great workout for your laughing muscles! (Station info).

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: The US brand Cadillac from Detroit stands for the American way of drive and exuberant luxury made in the USA. The Cadillac Series 62 Convertible from 1949 was the first US car to have the famous and often quoted tail fins. A beefy V8 engine, automatic transmission and electric top are a given for a Caddy of this era. Classic Ride revives the American Way of Drive with the tailfin monster. (Station info).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.desc: In the first episode of 2021, top speed presenter Martin Utberg looks back on the past year, 2020. A year in which hardly any classic car events took place due to the corona pandemic. Nevertheless, the Top Speed ​​editors managed to fill the planned 26 episodes with interesting topics and guests. This episode contains pictures from: the Classica Ice Marathon, the Black Forest Winter Challenge, Retro Classics in Stuttgart, the Oldtimer Galerie Toffen and the Mac Museum in Singen. Prominent guests such as Jochen Mass, Hans-Joachim “Strietzel” Stuck and Prince Leopold of Bavaria complete this episode. (Station info).

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Rollovers, ramp jumps, crashes – there are 1000 ways to destroy cars. They all know the Stunt Heroes! The report looks back at the car highlights of the last few months. (Station info).

programme.title: Biker Lifestyle
programme.desc: Slovenia – There are many motorcycle destinations in Europe, but hardly anyone thinks of Slovenia. On our tour through Slovenia we discovered that a visit on two wheels is definitely worth it. Various landscapes with high mountain ranges, low mountain ranges and hilly areas, as well as the Slovenian Riviera, have their charm. On our tours we visit Lake Bled, Ljubljana, eastern Slovenia, the Postojna Caves and of course Piran, the Slovenian Riviera. The highlights and spectacular drone flights can be seen in the film. (Station info).

programme.title: On Tour
programme.desc: Today from the Supercross Cup in Munich. With the best drivers from all over the world traveling to take home the crown - who will be King of Munich? We don't know yet, but in a few minutes we'll be a little wiser - the highlight of the indoor motorsport scene this season. (Station info).

programme.title: Classic
programme.desc: In 1949, a Danube ring race was started for the first time on a 4 km long city circuit in Ingolstadt. Up to 100,000 spectators lined the roadside in the years that followed. Since the Donauring Revival in 1999, the race has now taken place on a 1.6 km long section of the former route. Classic is on site. And: A look behind the scenes of leather restoration at Kienle in Heimerdingen. (Station info).

programme.title: Green wave
programme.desc: In 1996 he was a pioneer in hybrid drives: the Toyota Prius. The fourth generation is already on the market in 2016. What has happened since then and how forward-looking is the Prius? Hydrogen propulsion is also not a new phenomenon. But there still doesn't seem to be any momentum in the fuel cell vehicle market. Can the Hyundai ix35 Fuel Cell change that? (Station info).

programme.title: Made in....
programme.desc: The name Rolls Royce has always stood for exclusivity, luxury and British automotive engineering. The legendary vehicles with the Spirit of Ecstasy on the radiator grille have been built in England since the beginning of the 20th century. Today it is mainly very wealthy people who make the decision to purchase a Rolls Royce. No two ordered models are the same. Because the Bespoke customization department leaves no wish for individualization unfulfilled and so each vehicle is an absolutely unique piece. Made in takes a look behind the scenes at the Rolls Royce factory in southern England. (Station info).

programme.title: Four-wheel drive adventure
programme.desc: A special interest magazine about off-road and all-wheel drive vehicles. The focus is on off-road veterans and cars with four-wheel drive. Rustic, angular, and almost exactly the same as before. The Nissan X Trail. Externally it can only be distinguished from its predecessor at the third glance, even though nothing in this SUV has actually remained the same. (Station info).

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Today's episode of Perfect Ride is dominated by tough guys and hot stunts. We take a look behind the scenes at Action Concept, the largest action film producer in Europe. And: The Stuck test on the track. This time with none other than the Alpina D5 Biturbo! (Station info).

programme.title: 4x4 – Das Allrad Magazin
programme.desc: Station wagons are practical pack donkeys with lots of space, family carriages or both. But the Skoda Octavia Scout and Opal Insignia Country Tourer want to be more. They awaken the adventurer's instinct with their off-road look. Increased ground clearance, wheel covers, underrun protection and side paneling give them the off-road look - their all-wheel drive ensures the right traction off paved roads. So it doesn’t always have to be just an SUV. Cross suits in the test. (Station info).

programme.title: Tuning – it doesn’t get any lower than that!
programme.desc: The Mechatronik company is a specialist in Mercedes classic cars. The team has been dedicated to restoring and refining classic cars since 1997. Also: The Nissan 370 Z is serious competition for Posche Cayman & Co, at an unbeatable price. And: The Chevrolet Camaro is a real American muscle car. Now the current Camaro is finally available in Europe. In addition: This is undoubtedly the most powerful opponent of the BMW X5M or X6M. The Mercedes ML 63 AMG. (Station info).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.sub-title: Classics on the way to auction
programme.desc: In this episode of Top Speed, presenter Martin Utberg visits the vintage car gallery in Toffen, Switzerland. It has been a regular address for lovers of classic automobiles for over four decades and is known for its regular vintage car auctions. Together with auctioneer Serge Stotzer and his team, Martin takes a look behind the scenes of the preparations for the next auction. Some of the vehicles that will go under the hammer on Saturday, March 21st will be presented in more detail - and Martin will also get behind the wheel himself to experience these classics on the road. An exciting preview (channel information).

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Exciting and breathtaking, it is the archetype of all sports cars, the Jaguar E-Type. The mini skirt and its long hood characterize the style of the sexy sixties. The E-Type is a sports car of the century whose shapes still quicken the pulse today. The most beautiful car ever built is too beautiful to have a successor. Those responsible at Jaguar waited almost 40 years before they dared to continue the legend. (Station info).

programme.title: Super Cars
programme.desc: For fans of sports cars, the name Pagani sounds like thunder. Because the 12-cylinder high-performance engines that the Italian manufacturer uses in its super sports cars make the earth shake. The small car manufacturer is located in San Cesario sul Panaro and their new Huayra model is more brutal than almost any other sports car - and is one of the most exclusive things you can buy. Former Formula 1 driver Adrian Sutil will test this “uber car” for us. (Station info).

Together with auctioneer Serge Stotzer and his team, Martin takes a look behind the scenes of the preparations for the next auction. Some of the vehicles that will go under the hammer on Saturday, March 21st will be presented in more detail - and Martin will also get behind the wheel himself to experience these classics on the road. An exciting preview (channel information).

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Exciting and breathtaking, it is the archetype of all sports cars, the Jaguar E-Type. The mini skirt and its long hood characterize the style of the sexy sixties. The E-Type is a sports car of the century whose shapes still quicken the pulse today. The most beautiful car ever built is too beautiful to have a successor. Those responsible at Jaguar waited almost 40 years before they dared to continue the legend. (Station info).

programme.title: Biker Lifestyle
programme.desc: Slovenia – There are many motorcycle destinations in Europe, but hardly anyone thinks of Slovenia. On our tour through Slovenia we discovered that a visit on two wheels is definitely worth it. Various landscapes with high mountain ranges, low mountain ranges and hilly areas, as well as the Slovenian Riviera, have their charm. On our tours we visit Lake Bled, Ljubljana, eastern Slovenia, the Postojna Caves and of course Piran, the Slovenian Riviera. The highlights and spectacular drone flights can be seen in the film. (Station info).

programme.title: Classic
programme.desc: Ferrari has its roots in racing like no other manufacturer and almost every racing car produced since 1947 has survived to this day in some form. In order to properly showcase this racing museum, the Historic Challenge was founded in 1995 - a one-make cup for historic racing cars. Classic presents the racing series. (Station info).

programme.title: Green wave
programme.desc: The automotive industry is currently changing completely: vehicles are developing into autonomous, fully networked digital devices. Road safety should improve significantly. But how do assistance systems actually work? And how safe are self-driving cars? MOTORVISION looks over the shoulders of Daimler engineers – shortly before the launch of the new S-Class in autumn 2017. (Station information).

programme.title: Made in....
programme.sub-title: The history of the fire department
programme.desc: The history of the fire department goes back to Roman times. At that time, it was primarily slaves who had to expose themselves to the burning danger. In the Middle Ages, the guilds were responsible for fighting fires, but it was only with one man that the fire department in Germany was sustainably structured: Conrad Dietrich Magirus. He is considered the pioneer in firefighting technology. To this day, the most modern fire engines are built 100 percent by hand in his hometown of Ulm. MOTORVISION TV takes a look behind the scenes of the company with over 150 years of history and shows the production of turntable ladders and fire engines. (Station info).

programme.desc: The British county of Chesire, in the tranquil town of Crewe, has been home to one of the most exclusive automobile manufacturers for 70 years: Bentley Motors. 400 hours of pure manual work, meticulous accuracy, a lot of technical know-how and a lot of passion from the employees turn the top model, the Bentley Mulsanne, into a sculpture on wheels. At Bentley, not only luxury traditionally plays a role, but also performance.
